title: ShopItemVariantData
description: Shop item data, represents a request to add an shop item to the Tradera system.

title.description: The title (short description) of the item (80 chars).

description.description: A long (7000 chars) description of the item.

categoryId.description:
The category Id. See the method
!:PublicService.GetCategories for all available categories.

acceptedBuyerId.description:
The types of Buyers allowed to buy the Item. See the method
!:PublicService.GetAcceptedBidderTypes for a list.

shippingOptions.description: A list of shipping options offered to the buyer of the Item. At most 3 shipping options are allowed if Pickup is included. Otherwise, at most 2 shipping options are allowed. See Tradera.Api.Services.Core.Contracts.Entities.ItemShipping.

paymentOptionIds.description:
An array of ids of Payment types (more than one can be specified).
See the method !:PublicService.GetItemFieldValues for a list.

shippingCondition.description: Describes Shipping condition for this Item (500 chars)

paymentCondition.description: Describes Payment condition for this Item (500 chars)

ownReferences.description: The sellers own references for this Item (60 chars).

vat.description: VAT for the item. The VAT value can be retrieved from API method !:PublicService.GetItemFieldValues.

itemImages.description:
Shop item images, an array of Tradera.Api.Services.Core.Contracts.Entities.ItemImageData objects (max 40 images).
Max accepted size: 4MB

activateDate.description: Date when Shop item will be active on Tradera.

deactivateDate.description: Date when Shop item will be deactivated on Tradera.

quantity.description:
Modify the available quantity for this Item. This is a delta and will
be added to the current quantity. Use a negative value to decrease the
quantity.

absoluteQuantity.description:
Set the quantity to an absolute value, regardless of the current quantity.
It is not allowed to provide both AbsoluteQuantity and Quantity in the
same request.

externalId.description: The id of the item in external system.

sellerPartNo.description: Required id of the item in external system.

descriptionLanguageCodeIso2.description: The description language code of the item.

hasMega.description: If the Image should have a Mega image created when processed.

ItemImageData.description: Holds information for an item image.

shippingOptionId.description: OBSOLETE: Use Tradera.Api.Services.Core.Contracts.Entities.ItemShipping.ShippingProviderId instead. Takes the same numeric ids.

shippingProviderId.description:
The numeric id of the shipping provider. Call GetShippingOptions (SOAP) or
GET /v4/reference-data/shipping-options (REST) for the providers a seller can use — every
product returned carries the ShippingProviderId to send back. The set changes over time,
so read it from the API rather than hard-coding it.
            
DEPRECATED providers, rejected when listing an item: Posten (1), Bussgods (3), UPS (4),
FedEx (5), NotSpecified (10) and PostNordStampDenmark (15). Sellers who used Posten should
use PostNordParcel (12) or Alternative (6) instead.

sellerSurcharge.description:
Optional seller-defined surcharge added on top of the shipping product's base cost.
Not yet used to compute the buyer-facing shipping price — Tradera.Api.Services.Core.Contracts.Entities.ItemShipping.Cost is still
the authoritative, required field today and must be sent. In a future API revision,
Tradera.Api.Services.Core.Contracts.Entities.ItemShipping.Cost will be removed and the buyer-facing price will be derived from
the shipping product (identified by Tradera.Api.Services.Core.Contracts.Entities.ItemShipping.ShippingProductId) adjusted by
Tradera.Api.Services.Core.Contracts.Entities.ItemShipping.SellerSurcharge and Tradera.Api.Services.Core.Contracts.Entities.ItemShipping.SellerDiscount.

sellerDiscount.description:
Optional seller-defined discount subtracted from the shipping product's base cost.
Not yet used to compute the buyer-facing shipping price — Tradera.Api.Services.Core.Contracts.Entities.ItemShipping.Cost is still
the authoritative, required field today and must be sent. In a future API revision,
Tradera.Api.Services.Core.Contracts.Entities.ItemShipping.Cost will be removed and the buyer-facing price will be derived from
the shipping product (identified by Tradera.Api.Services.Core.Contracts.Entities.ItemShipping.ShippingProductId) adjusted by
Tradera.Api.Services.Core.Contracts.Entities.ItemShipping.SellerSurcharge and Tradera.Api.Services.Core.Contracts.Entities.ItemShipping.SellerDiscount.

name.description: Name of the attribute, e.g. Size

variantGroupId.description: Id grouping all Items that are variants of each other.

variantAttributes.description: Collection of variant attributes for the item.
